# @noble/post-quantum 0.7.1 (vendored)

Vendored copy of the published package. MIT. Implements the FIPS 203 / 204 / 205 primitives named
in the whitepaper appendix.

Used by: `reserve/fips203` (ML-KEM), `reserve/fips204-205` (ML-DSA, SLH-DSA).

Status note: this is an independent implementation, not a FIPS validation. Do not read its presence
as "we are post-quantum ready".

Not wired into any build. See `../provenance.md`.
